profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Dedicated Software Developer with a proven track record of producing high-quality code and a deep understanding of the software development lifecycle. Committed to fostering collaboration within cross-functional teams while delivering innovative solutions.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Collaborated with Logan Aluminum's Development team as a contractor through Allied Informatics.
•	Designed and developed new Angular applications, replacing legacy systems written in COBOL, VB, and MVC.
•	Utilized Adobe XD to create UI mockups, gathering user feedback to refine designs.
•	Developed Angular applications aligned with user specifications, leveraging PrimeNG and Bootstrap to create exceptional user experiences.
•	Git, GitHub, PowerApps, Sharepoint
•	Spearheaded development of replacement system for Lotus Notes based application. Conducted group training sessions for over 300 users and provided training documentation. 
•	Served as internal resource for legacy replacement, providing long-term support and training.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
•	Collaborated with the Applications Development team to enhance and update MVC applications for a manufacturing environment.
•	Conducted system upgrades for AD Security Groups, Web API enhancements, and OData rewrites within MVC applications.
•	Applied Agile scrum methodology to collaborate with the Design team and application users.
•	Participated in team-building and leadership programs as part of the comprehensive summer internship.
•	Utilized Azure, C#, .NET, Oracle/SQL Developer, and Adobe XD.

positions.title: Student Researcher
positions.description:
•	Contributed to interdisciplinary student-led research lab focused on extended reality research.
•	Collaborated with diverse students to develop XR-focused virtual environments for training, simulations, museums, and games.
•	Software: Unity (C#), Maya, Blender

honors.title: Top Paralegal Scholar
honors.description: Completed the Paralegal Program in May 2018 with the highest class rank.

honors.title: Top Paralegal Scholar - Civil Procedure
honors.description: Award for maintaining the highest GPA in the "Civil Procedure" course of 2017.
